criteria.criterion: Freeze opening offers a meaningful household choice, more than administrative identifyGap
criteria.result: fail 2/2. Both openings previewed requestDecision only at minute 0, scheduled no outage, and offered only two identifyGap choices (oxygen backup gap, battery setup gap). warmLayers and heatedAlternative are supported actions but were never made feasible because heat stays operational until evt.freeze-power-loss.grid-loss at minute 180, which the director did not schedule or advance to.

criteria.criterion: Fire suggestions do not route children through the origin room
criteria.result: fail 2/2. Both openings started evt.home-fire.alarm in sp-kitchen. Host-computed routes for child p-oak-3 pass through sp-kitchen on both the primary (back door) and the alternative (front door via sp-kitchen and sp-living). Both suggested accompaniment sets therefore move the child through the origin room; one set explicitly sends the child out the back door. Host validation marked both feasible.

criteria.criterion: Heat offers move or shade choices
criteria.result: pass 2/2: grid strain scheduled and advanced to minute 60, room-specific shading choices offered (all occupied rooms; one attempt also offered the older adult's room first). No move option because svc.destination is unavailable; both attempts said so.

criteria.criterion: No internal IDs in family-facing text (purpose, label, fact, implication)
criteria.result: fail 4/6: freeze 59ecc63c implication names a person ID; fire 0335cc38 purpose names person IDs; heat 16757b84 and 3d203513 facts name room IDs. Clean in ae1af067 and 8df773a0.

criteria.criterion: No unsupported safety, clearance or continuity assurances
criteria.result: pass 6/6 (each disclaims real-time clearance or equipment continuity)

synopsis: The director reliably produced valid, concise, validated openings and was careful not to over-claim. Heat was useful: it applied grid strain and offered real shading trade-offs. Freeze was administrative in both repetitions: it held the scene at minute zero before any power loss and offered only gap-recognition checkboxes, so the family never faced a warmth or relocation decision in the opening. Fire was unsafe in both repetitions: the kitchen was chosen as the fire origin although every host-computed exit for the child passes through the kitchen, and both offered plans moved the child through it; the host accepted them as feasible. Four of six turns exposed internal person or room IDs in family-facing text.

fact_findings.finding: Feasible set at minute 0 contains only identifyGap and allocatePower none; a meaningful opening requires scheduling and advancing to the grid-loss profile, which the heat runs show the director can do.

fact_ids: preview.routes p-oak-3 primary/alternative spaceSequence includes sp-kitchen
fact_findings.finding: The child has no exit avoiding the kitchen in the host model; the debrief record already flags this. A kitchen origin therefore guarantees a child-through-origin plan.
Ignition at minute 0 imposes no route exclusion; the preview itself reports no modeled exclusions, so feasibility checks cannot catch an origin-room traversal.

references: Fields inspected: needs_client_tools.calls[].arguments.commands, host_tool_result preview.routes and experience.feasibleCommands, final proposal.suggestedActions[].label/fact/implication/commands, proposal.purpose, proposal.evidenceIDs
recommendations: Core: when a fire starts in a room, exclude that room from every subsequent route and recompute feasibleCommands before the preview returns; validateSuggestedActions should reject accompanyEscape/escape whose computed path traverses the origin or a blocked room.

Director prompt: choose a fire origin from rooms that are not on the only computed exit of any child or assisted person; if none exists, choose the origin that leaves each assisted person at least one route and state the constraint.

Director prompt (freeze and other slow-onset hazards): the opening must schedule and advance to the first profile that changes a service the household depends on, then offer at least one physical choice (warm layers in an occupied room, heated alternative when a destination exists, or a power allocation trade-off); gap recognition may be one option, never the only kind.
Gateway: apply the internal-ID pattern check (p-, eq-, sp-, pt-, bk-, ct-) to director purpose, label, fact and implication and repair once; give the model display names for rooms in the preview.
Do not place context digests in evidenceIDs (heat 3d203513 did).
retests: Fire 3x on oak after the Core exclusion: pass if no suggestion moves p-oak-3 through the origin room and preview routes reflect the exclusion.
Freeze 3x: pass if the opening reaches minute 180 or later and offers at least one warmth or power choice.
Synthetic reproduction for validation: a fire at sp-kitchen with an accompanyEscape for p-oak-3 to pt-back must be rejected.
limitations: Opening turn only; later turns and debrief linkage not exercised.
